svg.title: Approve one password fill
svg.desc: The official worker checks the browser target, requests one password through NativeHost, and the desktop checks policy and obtains approval. Denial or stale state returns no secret. A successful response contains the selected username and password; the worker rechecks the target before filling without submission.
